name: rounds-app
description: A local canvas of everything your Claude Code sessions make: screens, pages and pushed changes, by project and topic, with a time machine, before and after, and notes that go back to the session.
author: Kris Puckett

scripts.topics: node -e "import('./server/topics.mjs').then(async (t) => { const i = JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(require('path').join(require('os').homedir(), require('fs').existsSync(require('os').homedir() + '/.rounds') ? '.rounds' : '.workbench', 'index.json'), 'utf8')); console.log(await t.fileTopics(i, { log: console.log })); })"
